status.label: Investigate duplicate result identities
status.detail: Reports include UWP and PWA duplicates; a separate Win32 example was acknowledged to be distinct executables.

next_action.label: Trace PWA/UWP index versus displayed results
next_action.reason: The public duplicate PWA report includes a diagnostic archive and a usable reproduction.

judgment.rationale: The discussion contains competing index and UX explanations; the confirmed duplicate #33322 supplies an Edge PWA reproduction. No evidence supports the old claim of assigned ownership.
evidence: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/17843#issuecomment-1110311018 says reinstalling the UWP app stopped that case and clarifies that the notepad.exe entries were distinct executable paths.
https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/17843#issuecomment-1110101511 reports correct plugin query results during a separate debugging observation, suggesting a UX branch.
https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/33322 is closed as a duplicate of this issue and includes Edge PWA steps plus a diagnostic ZIP.
Current PackageRepository already subscribes to install/uninstall/update events and removes matching package entries.
judgment.recommended_action: Compare indexed identities, plugin query results and UI rows during PWA and UWP lifecycle operations.

fix_assessment.rationale: No concrete linked PR covers the observed duplicates. Existing package-event removal means a simplistic missing-uninstall-handler fix would be stale.

proposed_fixes.title: Prevent duplicate identities across indexing and result replacement
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: lifecycle refresh or asynchronous result replacement can retain the same launch identity more than once. Distinct shortcuts, PWA registration duplication and duplicated UI rows remain separate possibilities.
plan: Reproduce Edge PWA duplicates from #33322 and record launch identity/source path at the Win32/PWA index, plugin output and displayed-row boundaries.

For UWP cases, inspect src/modules/launcher/Plugins/Microsoft.Plugin.Program/Storage/PackageRepository.cs event ordering and equality/removal behavior; preserve its existing uninstall/update handling.

Correct the first boundary that duplicates the same identity: make repository refresh idempotent if index duplication is proven, or fix stale query-generation/UI result replacement if plugin output is unique.
Add lifecycle and rapid-query regression tests while retaining distinct applications and legitimate shortcuts with the same display name.
verification: Install, update, remove and reinstall a test PWA/UWP app; repeated identical queries yield one row per genuine launch identity.
Rapid typing and delayed plugin completion do not append stale rows; distinct executable paths with identical titles remain available.

confidence.rationale: The identity/lifecycle boundary fits several reports, but the first duplicating layer must be measured and not all examples necessarily share a cause.

issue_context.summary: Run sometimes shows repeated UWP/PWA results or missing icons. The discussion separates real duplicate launch identities from legitimate same-name executables.
known_information: Initially reported on 0.57.2; a 0.81.1 Edge PWA case appears in duplicate #33322.
A UWP reinstall resolved one contributor's episode.
A contributor observed a possible cross-plugin UX issue, while the PWA reporter narrowed their own case to PWA entries.
The live issue is open, unassigned and needs team response.
inferences: More than one duplication mechanism may be represented.
Deduplicating by display name alone would hide legitimate programs and is unsafe.
issue_context.analysis: Use the available PWA reproduction and archive to locate the first duplicated identity. Do not repeat a generic log request that a maintainer already considered unhelpful for the timing branch.
initial_investigation: Read all ten comments and the report.
Read #33322, including its diagnostic attachment and explicit duplicate closure.
Verified current upstream PackageRepository has package event subscriptions and RemovePackage matching logic; absence of an uninstall handler is not a valid current root cause.
Issue timeline contains no concrete linked PR.

reproduce.title: Separate index duplicates from stale UI rows
reproduce.version_requirement: Start with the 0.81.1 PWA report; compare a current supported build.
prerequisites: Edge with an installed test PWA such as YouTube
Use a disposable test application for install/remove cycles.
steps: 1. Query the installed PWA name and record each result's launch target/source.
2. Compare repository items, plugin-returned results and displayed rows for the same query generation.
3. Remove/reinstall the test PWA, repeat queries and restart Run to distinguish persistent indexing from transient UI duplication.
4. Repeat with a UWP test app and rapid query changes; retain legitimate same-name shortcuts in a control case.
reproduce.expected_result: One UI row per genuine launch identity; identify the earliest layer where duplicates first appear.

actions.label: Review identity-safe deduplication plan
actions.note: Choose the index or UI correction only after tracing the first duplication boundary.
